interface.defaultPrompt: What's out there for my current project? Search techtwitterideas and recommend the best-fitting ideas, tools and techniques.
interface.longDescription: Search the public techtwitterideas knowledge base, understand your project, and rank up to five relevant tools or techniques with source links, practical first steps, caveats, and a combo idea. Recommendations stay grounded in the curated repository.

name: techtwitterideas
description: Find ideas, tools and techniques for the user's current project from github.com/raghavmurthy/techtwitterideas, curated from tech Twitter.
